notes.title: Update 8/8/2023
notes.content:
This is a small update to correct a couple of small bugs. 
- Fixed spacing of columns in the leaderboards (for positions >99)
- Tweaked the phrasing in a couple of spanish translations to make the shorter
- Added a checkpoint to Kingsdown to prevent track-cutting

notes.title: New content update brings the total to 30 tracks and 67 cars!
notes.content:
[b]New track[/b]: This is the 30th track that comes to the game, and its one of my favorite ones: Mount Panorama!
[b]New cars[/b]: Formula Pretend received three new liveries inspired in classic cars
[b]New sounds[/b]: crowd sounds were completely redone to make them more natural and less repetitive

notes.title: New track, cars and added support for languages!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] [b]New track[/b]: with the addition of South Africa, PCR has at least a track for every continent!
[*] [b]New cars[/b]: Formula Pretend adds two classic liveries
[*] [b]Support for languages[/b]: you can now choose to play in English or Spanish
[*] Added a [b]checkpoint[/b] in Buenos Aires to avoid track-cutting
[*] Improved game mode [b]graphics[/b] in the menus
[/list]

notes.title: New track, new cars and UX improvements
notes.content:
[list]
[*] [b]New track[/b]: You can now fight for the top positions in the leaderboard in [b]Buenos Aires[/b]!
[*] [b]New cars[/b]: Two new german contenders for the Classics category
[*] [b]Mini-map[/b]: Tweaked the display information and now all cars positions are drawn in the mini-map
[*] [b]Improved overlays[/b]: better legibility and more information shown when completing a lap (current position and laps are shown next to your car). Shortened the text shown when doing a lap record for faster reading.
[*] [b]New guardrails[/b]: Buenos Aires is the first track using a new method for placing guardrails, after further testing, other tracks will get this upgrade.
[/list]
